scope: Portable publication of existing static evidence only. No source changes, builds, runtime probes or new fixture results.
portability_changes: Resolve analysis inputs inside sealed/ and ELF helper inside portable/.
ELF helper removes unused repository-root discovery.
Portable analysis prints to stdout when invoked directly, instead of writing sealed analysis.json.
Verifier checks bundled closure archive and source bytes; historical work/cache paths remain provenance text only.
limitations: No exhaustive malformed-input, runtime, recursive transitive or full-executable equivalence proof.
Only direct decoder callers are inventoried; indirect invocation is not disproven.
Original bounds use next-known entries; candidate bounds additionally have symbols.
